init_service_name.description: The name of the service used for the PID file.

maxdaemons.description: Maximum number of POP3 servers started

maxperip.description: Maximum number of connections to accept from the same IP address

pop3auth.description: Authentication mechanisms to advertise (e.g., LOGIN CRAM-MD5)

pop3auth_orig.description: Original list of supported authentication mechanisms for webadmin

pop3auth_tls.description: Authentication mechanisms to advertise when TLS is enabled

pop3auth_tls_orig.description: Original list of TLS authentication mechanisms for webadmin

port.description: Port to listen on for connections

address.description: IP address to listen on. 0 means all IP addresses.

defdomain.description: Optional default domain suffix for usernames

pop3dstart.description: Flag to enable/disable starting the service via startup scripts

maildirpath.description: Directory name of the maildir directory
